program_name: Sport for Social Development in Indigenous Communities — Stream Two
funder: Sport Canada / Department of Canadian Heritage
amount_notes: Up to $249,999 over two years (not annual)
organization_types_eligible: First Nation or Band Council recognized by Government of Canada
Tribal Council recognized by registered First Nation Bands
Metis Nation or government recognized by Government of Canada
NFP organization that is Indigenous-owned and/or operated (51%+) and primarily serves Indigenous Peoples
eligibility_criteria: Organization must be Indigenous-owned and/or operated (51%+ Indigenous shareholders and/or staff)
Organization must primarily serve Indigenous Peoples with mandate for Section 35 rights holders
Project must promote sport and recreation in Indigenous communities
Project activities must occur between April 1 2026 and March 31 2028
Maximum funding request is $249,999 over the two-year period
exclusions: Stream One reserved for Provincial/Territorial Aboriginal Sport Bodies only
Stream Three reserved for projects serving Indigenous women, girls, and 2SLGBTQI+ peoples only
Expenses incurred prior to April 1 2026 not eligible
notes: 2026-2028 intake is NOW CLOSED as of April 2026. Next call for applications scheduled Fall 2027. Write to grants_expired.json not grants_verified.json. Monitor for Fall 2027 reopening.
validation_warnings: deadline_unknown - verify before using in Tier 1 or Tier 2 classification

program_name: Sport Canada Community Sport for All Initiative
funder: Sport Canada / Department of Canadian Heritage
amount_notes: Funding disbursed to national-level organizations who then sub-grant to community organizations. Individual community grant amounts not publicly stated.
organization_types_eligible: Community organizations must apply through approved national-level intermediary organizations
eligibility_criteria: Must apply through a funded national-level intermediary organization, not directly to Sport Canada
Must serve under-represented groups: Black, Indigenous, racialized, 2SLGBTQI+, low-income, persons with disability, newcomers or seniors
Must be a non-governmental not-for-profit community-level organization
Project must remove barriers and increase sport participation rates for identified under-represented group
exclusions: Direct applications to Sport Canada not accepted — must go through intermediary national organizations
Municipalities and levels of government not eligible as ultimate recipients
Schools not eligible unless serving northern or remote Indigenous communities
Provincial-level organizations and PTSOs affiliated with NSOs not eligible
notes: IMPORTANT: Application intake is NOW CLOSED per official page. Current funded national organizations are disbursing to community orgs — Emerge Academy or similar clients should contact funded intermediaries directly to inquire about sub-grants. Write to grants_expired.json. Monitor for next intake cycle announcement.
validation_warnings: amount_unconfirmed - verify before using in client report
deadline_unknown - verify before using in Tier 1 or Tier 2 classification
